frozen: 2026-11-22, before any run of calib_cloud_floor.py with a real model

rule_M.probe: the built-in natural-question bank: issue95-evidence/synthetic, 30 facts with their blind keywords, 48 questions
rule_M.candidate: per question that passes the query gate: the single closest fact by cosine among trusted facts, when it is not already shown by the mode's own output, the block holds fewer than 7 facts and the fact passes the repeat, recallable and name checks
rule_M.kinds: rescue = the candidate is a target and the row had no target in its first five; extra = a target on a row that already had one; wrong = not a target (answerable or not)
rule_M.curve: for tau in 0.05..0.99 step 0.01: R = rescues with cosine >= tau, W = wrong with cosine >= tau
rule_M.choice: tau with the largest R - W; ties: the longest run of grid points, the higher run among equal lengths, its midpoint (the higher of two middle points)
rule_M.verdict: the model adds something only when max(R - W) >= 1 and R >= 2 at the chosen tau; otherwise: this model adds nothing, keep the closest-fact admission off for it

modes.local: shown = base prefetch with embeddings off; vectors of content + ' ' + tags (the sidecar's text)
modes.cloud: shown = base prefetch with embeddings on (its own vector text, z gate at margin 1.0, no floor); the same vectors rank the candidate

check_against_existing_numbers.source: BUILTIN-QUESTIONS-RESULTS.md, synthetic prefetch table: (rescued, added non-answers) per model and threshold
check_against_existing_numbers.expected_from_those_points: bge-m3: gain, tau between 0.55 and 0.58 or above; the two small models: no tabulated point with R - W >= 1
check_against_existing_numbers.implementation_check: local mode with bge-m3 must give the three bge-m3 pairs above at 0.52, 0.55 and 0.58

confirmation.new_data: household en, ru, zh (199 facts, 115 questions each), not used to pick any threshold
confirmation.pass_when_gain: at the tau chosen on the built-in bank: rescued > 0 and wrong <= rescued on each language (BUILTIN's pass condition; nothing can be lost, the rule only appends)
confirmation.pass_when_no_gain: no household language has its own best R - W >= 1 with R >= 2; otherwise the verdict missed a real gain

rule_M2.written: 2026-11-22, after the bank result above and before any household run of calib_cloud_floor.py
rule_M2.why: R - W is flat at +1 on a bank with 7 word-missed questions, and the longest-run tie rule then picks the strictest run. M2 states the accepted trade directly, as BUILTIN's pass condition does.
rule_M2.choice: the lowest tau with R >= 2 and W <= R on the built-in bank; none: this model adds nothing
rule_M2.confirmation: unchanged: on each household language, at the bank's tau, rescued > 0 and wrong <= rescued; for a 'nothing' verdict, no language with its own lowest feasible tau
rule_M2.seen_when_written: the bank curves of both modes; BUILTIN's real-store rows; household zh local mode at 0.55 (7 rescued, 16 non-answers added), which already fails the confirmation condition for M2's bge-m3 value. Household en and ru and every cloud-mode household result were unseen.

outcome.rule_M: failed its check on the bank (calls bge-m3 'adds nothing')
outcome.rule_M2: fits the numbers on record; fails confirmation on all three household languages in local mode (at 0.55: zh 7 rescued / 16 wrong, en 8 / 12, ru 5 / 17); its 'nothing' verdict for cloud mode is contradicted on zh (own lowest feasible tau 0.66: 2 rescued / 1 wrong)

rule_P10.written: 2026-11-22, before any run with bge-small-zh, multilingual-minilm or multilingual-e5-small
rule_P10.bank: synthetic + household en, ru, zh pooled: 210 answerable and 183 no-answer questions; local shape (the base's word and entity output first, then the closest fact by cosine of content + ' ' + tags)
rule_P10.choice: the lowest tau on the 0.05..0.99 grid at which wrong facts appended to no-answer questions are at most 10% of the 183
rule_P10.verdict: the model adds nothing when fewer than 5 of the 210 answerable questions are rescued at that tau
rule_P10.reported: per model: tau, rescued / 210, wrong on no-answer / 183, and the same rate on each of the four sets
rule_P10.seen_when_written: every bge-m3 curve; for the two small models only BUILTIN's tabulated points; nothing for multilingual-e5-small, which stands in for a model nobody tuned for
rule_P10.note: the sidecar adds no query or passage prefix, so e5 is used as a user who just plugs it in would use it

rule_P10L.written: 2026-11-22, after leaving one set out of rule P10 on the four models' cached runs and reading the rule on language subsets of the bank; before any run of calib_model_tau.py on a frozen store
rule_P10L.why_revised: with the fourth set left out, 14 of 16 cells stayed at or under 12% wrong on no-answer questions; the two that did not were a model on a language missing from the three sets it was picked on (multilingual-e5-small on household zh 47%, bge-small-zh on household ru 61%), and the pooled cap had already left e5 at 30% on zh inside the bank
rule_P10L.bank: the sets in the languages the user writes in: zh = synthetic + household zh, en = household en, ru = household ru
rule_P10L.choice: the lowest tau on the 0.05..0.99 grid at which, on every one of those sets, wrong facts appended to no-answer questions are at most 10% of that set's no-answer questions
rule_P10L.verdict: the model adds nothing when fewer than 5 answerable questions of those sets are rescued at that tau (the count of rule P10, unchanged)

rule_P10L_store_check.written: 2026-11-22, before any run of calib_model_tau.py with --store on the frozen real store
rule_P10L_store_check.run: calib_model_tau.py --langs zh --store <frozen copy> --queries <its labels>, once for each of bge-m3, multilingual-minilm, multilingual-e5-small and bge-small-zh; the store is read through calib_cloud_floor.py --suite real with a local model, counts only
rule_P10L_store_check.cap_holds: at the picked tau, wrong facts appended to the store's no-answer questions are at most 10% of its no-answer questions
rule_P10L_store_check.verdict_holds: a model the bank says adds something: at the picked tau the store has at least 1 rescued question and no more wrong facts appended than rescued questions. A model the bank says adds nothing: the store's own labels find no threshold with at least 2 rescued and no more wrong than rescued (choose_m2 is None)
rule_P10L_store_check.method_holds: cap_holds for every model with a picked tau. verdict_holds is reported per model and is not part of it: what a model can add depends on the content
rule_P10L_store_check.seen_when_written: the frozen store through the shipped plugin, from BUILTIN-QUESTIONS-RESULTS.md (rescued / added non-answers): bge-m3 0.52 6/3, 0.55 6/3, 0.58 3/2; bge-small-zh 0.50 5/12, 0.64 1/0; multilingual-minilm 0.52 1/3, 0.58 0/1; nothing for multilingual-e5-small
